stem:
Here is a cone. Part of its surface is flat and part of its surface is curved.

[Image: A cone]

Which of these solids also has both a flat surface and a curved surface?
figure_description: The figure in the stem is an upright circular cone resting on an elliptical-perspective circular base with a dashed rear edge. Option A shows a rectangular prism with all flat faces and dashed lines for interior/hidden edges. Option B shows a sphere with a dashed horizontal equator indicating curvature. Option C shows a triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) with flat triangular faces and dashed lines for hidden base edges. Option D shows a right circular cylinder standing upright, with a flat circular top, a flat circular bottom (with a dashed rear edge), and a curved lateral side.
